ValidationRule.description: Invoice Status cannot be changed after Tax Invoice.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( AND( OR(ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(Invoice_Status__c),'Tax Invoice'),ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(Invoice_Status__c),'Initiate Tax Invoice')), ISPICKVAL(Invoice_Status__c,'Proforma Invoice')),true,false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invoice Status cannot be changed to Proforma Invoice after Tax Invoice and Initiate Tax Invoice.
